name: All Social Share
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
All Social Share is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that adds responsive social share buttons to posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.

Easily enable sharing across popular networks like Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, and more — with custom icon colors, toggle display positions, and mobile-ready styling.

🔹 Key Features

  • Add share buttons to posts, pages, and products
  • Choose display position: left, right, or below content
  • Supports major platforms: Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Email, Telegram, Gmail, Print
  • Responsive and mobile-optimized
  • Color picker for custom icon styling
  • Easily toggle which platforms to display
  • Simple admin settings panel — no coding required

Usage

Once activated and configured, share buttons will automatically appear on selected content types. You can control:

  • Which social platforms to display
  • Where to show buttons (left, right, or below content)
  • Icon colors with the built-in color picker
  • Whether to show on mobile devices

New Feature

🎨 Custom Icon Colors
Choose your preferred icon color using the admin color picker. All frontend icons will reflect the selected style.

Supported Networks (with Privacy Policy Links)

This plugin uses external services to enable sharing:

  • Facebook
    Share URL: https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php
    Privacy Policy

  • Twitter
    Share URL: https://twitter.com/intent/tweet
    Privacy Policy

  • LinkedIn
    Share URL: https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle
    Privacy Policy

  • Pinterest
    Share URL: https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/
    Privacy Policy

  • WhatsApp
    Share URL: https://api.whatsapp.com/send
    Privacy Policy

  • Gmail
    Share URL: https://mail.google.com/mail/
    Privacy Policy

  • Telegram
    Share URL: https://t.me/share/url
    Privacy Policy

  • Email (mailto)
    Uses the browser’s default email client.

  • Print
    Opens the user’s browser print dialog.

Support

Need help or want to request a feature?
Reach us via the WordPress.org support forum or PayPal contact page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/all-social-share
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → All Social Share to customize options
sections.faq:
❓ Can I change the icon color?

Yes! You can pick a custom color using the admin color picker.

❓ Can I show only specific platforms?

Absolutely. Enable or disable any icon directly from the settings panel.

❓ Can I hide share buttons on mobile?

Yes. There’s an option to disable mobile display.

❓ Will this work with WooCommerce products?

Yes! You can enable sharing for WooCommerce product pages too.
